text:
jamie: Quick check — opened PR to change ExternalSecrets rotation defaults and add a jitter annotation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4822. Need agreement on SLOs and rollout plan.

sasha: What defaults are we changing exactly?

jamie: Default TTL from 1h -> 30m, canary cluster will use 15m. New annotation `redwood.com/rotation-jitter: '0.2'` to stagger bursts. Terraform var is `module.externalsecrets.default_secret_ttl`.

noah: Will that increase vault read QPS during bursts? caching should help but want to be safe.

jamie: We added local KV prefix caching in the secret-refresher sidecar so most reads are cached. Worst case spike is during rollout/canary. Plan to ramp canary and watch the dashboard.

ci-bot: PR #4822 opened by jamie — infra/externalsecrets module. CI: tests/pass. :white_check_mark:

kelly: I can run the canary in staging today. Ping me when PR is merged and I'll start the 15m cluster.

jamie: Thanks — plan: merge 15:00 PT, canary in staging for 2 hours, then gradual across prod clusters. If vault read latency > 500ms or secret-refresh-lag alert fires we roll back.

sasha: Sounds fine. Add an alert rule to paging for >1m median secret-refresh-lag across pods for 5m.

jamie: Done — added alert: `alerts.yaml` snippet in the PR.

noah: Quick nit: confirm SA binding in staging for secret-refresher. Otherwise it will 403 during refresh.

jamie: Good catch. Check list for canary:
```
# staging checks
kubectl -n infra get sa secret-refresher
kubectl -n infra get rolebinding secret-refresher-binding
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/secret-refresher -c refresher | tail -n 50
```

kelly: Running the SA check now — looks good. Rolebinding exists and service account has `vault.read` policy.

jamie: Also added a small smokecheck command for oncall in runbook: `curl -sS https://grafana.redwood-infra/d/secret-refresh/overview?orgId=1` to verify panels.

infra-bot: Reminder: schedule window for prod rollouts is 22:00-02:00 UTC. Please confirm any exceptions.

jamie: Noted. We will target 23:00 UTC if staging canary is green.

noah: One more: terraform plan output shows a change to a managed path in Vault (`secret/data/externalsecrets/default`). We should shadow a copy before applying.

jamie: Agreed — I'll create a snapshot job and include rollback runbook in the PR description. Command I used locally: `vault kv get -format=json secret/data/externalsecrets/default > /tmp/es-default-backup-$(date +%s).json`

kelly: LGTM. I'll review the PR now and mark ready-to-merge after smoke checks. :eyes:

jamie: Thanks all — merging target 15:00 PT if no blockers. Will post updates in this thread and ping oncall if alert fires.
